login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: This instance has a single owner.
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
login.unreachable: The server did not answer. Check that it is running.
login.hint: Agents do not sign in here: they carry a token.

status.title: Status
status.subtitle: Whether each backing service is answering.

drive.emptyFolder: This folder holds no documents yet.
drive.pickDocument: Pick a document to see its card.

note.ready: Vectorised and queryable by any agent with permission.
note.processing: The switch is on; the queue is still vectorising.
note.pending: Switched on and waiting its turn in the queue.
note.failed: Switched on, but the last ingestion failed. No agent reads it until it is retried.
note.never: Never activated, so nothing was ever queued for it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Each agent has its own identity and tokens. Permissions are granted to agents, not to people.
agents.name: Name
agents.expiryHint: Leave it empty for a token that never expires.
agents.noTokens: This agent has no tokens, so nothing can authenticate as it.
agents.deleteAsk: Delete it with its tokens and rules?
agents.onlyOnce: This is the only time the token is shown.
agents.copyFailed: The browser refused clipboard access. Select the text and copy it by hand.
agents.tokenHint: Only its hash is stored, so it cannot be shown again. If it is lost, issue a new one and revoke this.

permissions.title: Permission simulator
permissions.subtitle: What one agent actually sees, with inheritance already resolved: the most specific rule wins and no rule means no access.
permissions.noAgents: Register an agent first: rules are written for agents.
permissions.noRules: No rule written yet, so this agent reaches nothing.
permissions.ownAllow: Own rule on this folder: allow.
permissions.ownDeny: Own rule on this folder: deny.
permissions.noRuleAnywhere: No rule anywhere on the path, so it stays denied.
permissions.clearHint: Removing it returns the folder to whatever it inherits.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: One collection per embedding model. Every folder points at the collection whose model indexes it.
